notes.title: 1.000 Update: Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to share an update for the Demo version with you. This update comes packed with fresh visuals and revamped level designs. We've also introduced more challenging puzzles and added some emotionally expressive bots to enhance your gaming experience.

The game now boasts a whopping 5,000 words, and we've included full voice-over support throughout. Additionally, we've implemented comprehensive controller support and key remapping features.

Without further ado, here's a sneak peek of the updated Room layout and some of the captivating Bot emotions:
[previewyoutube=_gvCEVOyQ0c;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We can't wait for you to experience these exciting improvements in the game. Stay tuned for more updates and enjoy the enhanced gameplay!

notes.title: 0.973 Update
notes.content:
The most major change - is a new Input system from Unreal 5.1
Remapping keys is now possible.
Besides that - not many changes to the sandbox, as we are currently working on Story Mode.
We have probably added more bugs to the sandbox - but that is a topic for the next update.
PS If you already played the Demo and have a save - your gun will jam at the begging of the game. Just change it via mouse wheel to another gun to unjam. I will fix it in the next update =)

notes.title: 0.970 Update
notes.content:
Hello, this is the first update after the Demo release on Steam.
Many things were reworked and updated.
Most critical - Trap Building. It was totally reworked - now it is smoother and offers some 'hacks' like building Cube on another Cube without the player moving to higher ground.
Most critical bug - traps double trigger on the first trigger after being built. (Thx Sever for founding it).
This bug was nasty - fixing it changes damage values - so we have to adjust some Story goals.

notes.title: Demo Update and Linux news
notes.content:
Hey guys,
since the release of the Demo version - we updated the game daily.
One major thing that we changed - was construction.
Here is a little tech video about how construction works now.
We using Unreal Engine for Happy Lab.

Another issue at hand - the Linux build. For some reason - while there is simply one button to click to package Linux build - it doesn't work 'as is'. Current state of Linux build: https://badim.itch.io/happylab
I'll upload all possible builds that Unreal can do later today.
As of now, let me quote r/user: "Okay, so the Windows version running on Linux in Wine works with DXVK.
If it turns out that the game runs well on Linux using the Windows version and you don't want to figure out how to get the Linux version working, at LEAST like, actually advertise that Linux is supported via Wine." Thx gardotd426!

We also have added a few more languages to the game.

There were around a hundred smaller fixes - I'm too tired to list them all. But - there will be more.
We are listening to player feedback via Steam and Discord - feel free to stop by and tell us what you think.
